title: Tallinn support gathering for Polish abortion-law protesters
notes: ERR reports support for people protesting Poland's abortion law and a march to the Polish embassy; no Estonian-government demand is shown. Crowd size not established in the read scope.

title: Tartu support rally for Polish abortion-law protesters
notes: ERR reports over 100 people at Tartu Town Hall Square supporting Polish protesters; the report frames the rally as support for Poland's abortion-law campaign. A speaker mentioned Estonia's debate but said the immediate concern was Poland; no separate domestic target is established.
